messages:
Sofia: quick follow-up thread from today's vendor outage affecting model fetch + auth. Need concrete owners for remediation items and comms. Who can pick these up? :wave:
Rakesh: saw spike in 502s when vendor auth retried and their model list paginated slowly. Impact: regen latency up X2 for 9m, a handful of requests timed out. Logged in postmortem draft.
Tom: I'll take the engineering mitigations: local model manifest cache with ETag-based validation + aggressive stale-while-revalidate. Plan: cache in redis, fallback reads, write-through invalidate on create/update. Owner: Tom. ETA: 5 business days.
Sofia: great. Add runbook step: on vendor auth degradation > 30% error rate, flip to cached-manifest mode and alert account ops. Owner: Sofia (runbook). ETA: Tue.
Rakesh: also adding token caching at the microservice layer with per-instance jittered refresh to avoid refresh storms. I'll push a middleware change and a small leaky-bucket limiter for refreshes. Owner: Rakesh. ETA: Wed EOD.
Tom: sample circuit-breaker config I propose:```json
{"failureThreshold":5, "timeoutMs":1200, "resetWindowMs":30000, "halfOpenRequests":3}
```
Can vet in staging.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy for token-cache-middleware v1.2 started at 2198765470
vendor-account: thanks for the timeline. we'll run auth trace extraction and share token endpoint latency histograms by EOD. Also open to adding an SLA clause for token p95.
Sofia: please capture vendor latency histos and call path — that'll help root cause. Also we'll request formal SLA language around token p95 and list call p99. Owner: Sofia (vendor comms). ETA: Fri.
Rakesh: ops ask: add a customer-impacted list for outreach if we do fallback mode. I'll maintain a minimal CSV of affected accounts and trigger a notification template. Owner: Rakesh. ETA: Thu.
Tom: QA: add a chaos experiment in the next reliability sprint that injects token delays + paginated list slowness. This should validate cache fallback and circuit breakers. Owner: Tom + SRE. ETA: next sprint.
Sofia: comms: we'll prepare a joint vendor post-incident review invite. Vendor asked for timeline and stack traces. I'll attach the timeline and a summary of mitigations.
vendor-account: we'll join the review and share a remediation plan on our side. Thanks for the proactive mitigations.
Tom: small detail: will add a metric for "manifest-fallback-rate" and an SLO burn alarm. Owner: Tom. ETA: Wed.
Rakesh: logging request: include vendor request-id in logs when calls fail so vendor can correlate. Owner: Rakesh. ETA: Mon.
Sofia: tallying actions in the postmortem doc: 
- Tom: local manifest cache + stale-while-revalidate, add manifest-fallback metric and SLO (ETA 5d / metric Wed)
- Rakesh: jittered token refresh + leaky-bucket limiter + include vendor request-id in logs (ETA Wed EOD / Mon)
- Sofia: runbook update + vendor comms + PIR invite (ETA Tue / Fri)
- Tom+SRE: chaos experiment for token/list latency (ETA next sprint)
- Rakesh: customer-impact CSV + notification template (ETA Thu)
Please react with :thumbsup: to accept ownership or :hand: to swap. We'll do a 10m check-in after owners ack to lock timelines.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Rakesh: :thumbsup: will need a 1d slip if the on-call rota changes, will flag if that happens.
Sofia: noted. I'll update the doc and schedule the 10m check-in at 09:30 tomorrow. Also adding a follow-up item: legal to review escrowed snapshots for top-ten customers.
vendor-account: sharing traces now. Expect a follow-up note with our internal findings.
Sofia: thanks all. Let's keep the remediation small and test-driven so we can roll forward quickly. :rocket:
